questions.q: X, Y and Z start a firm with ₹90,000, ₹1,20,000 and ₹1,50,000. X, the managing partner, gets an allowance of ₹4,000 a month. Z's share of the divisible profit is guaranteed to be at least ₹1,15,000, any shortfall being borne by Y alone. If the annual profit before X's allowance is ₹2,88,000, what does Y finally receive?
questions.why: Allowance 48,000; divisible 2,40,000 in 3:4:5 gives 60,000 / 80,000 / 1,00,000. Z is 15,000 short, which Y pays: 80,000 − 15,000 = 65,000. GPSC CBRT, Sep 2026.

questions.q: What is the profit per cent on an article? I. 5% discount is given on the list price. II. Without the discount, the profit would be 20%. III. The cost price is ₹5,000. Which statements are necessary?
questions.why: List = 1.2 × cost, sold at 0.95 × list = 1.14 × cost: 14% profit. The cost figure isn't needed. GPSC CBRT, Apr 2024.

questions.q: What comes next in the series? 3, 3, 6, 21, 102, …
questions.why: Multiply by 2, 3, 4, … and subtract 3 each time. Next: 609. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Meera walks 6 m South, then turns left and walks 2 m, then turns right and walks 8 m, then turns left and walks 9 m. Which direction is Meera facing now?
questions.why: Follow each turn from the first direction: the last leg is towards the East. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Identify the next term: A1Z, B3Y, D6X, G10W, K15V, …
questions.why: Letters +1, +2, +3, +4, +5 → P; numbers +2, +3, +4, +5, +6 → 21; last letters run back to U. GPSC CBRT, Jun 2025.

questions.q: Gauri bought things worth ₹25, of which 30 paise was sales tax at 6% on taxable items. What was the cost of the tax-free items?
questions.why: Taxable items: 0.30 ÷ 0.06 = ₹5. Tax-free = 25 − 5 − 0.30 = ₹19.70. GPSC CBRT, Sep 2024.

questions.q: 8 February 2005 was a Tuesday. What day was 8 February 2004?
questions.why: The span includes 29 Feb 2004: 366 days, two odd days back. GPSC CBRT, Jul 2024.

questions.q: If a non-leap year has 53 Sundays and 53 Mondays, which must be true about the next year?
opts: It will be a leap year starting on a Tuesday
It will have 53 Mondays and 53 Tuesdays
No such non-leap year can exist
questions.why: A 365-day year has only one day occurring 53 times. GPSC JSO pre-screening, Jun 2026.

questions.q: April has 30 days. The ratio of rainy days to sunny days in April could NOT be
questions.why: 5 : 3 needs 8 parts; 30 is not a multiple of 8. The others split 30 exactly. GPSC CBRT, Mar 2025.
